product.title: Big Sur Monterey and Carmel Tour From San Francisco
product.description: This full-day coastal route links Monterey Bay, Carmel-by-the-Sea, and Big Sur from a San Francisco departure. The itinerary follows Highway 1 and 17-Mile Drive corridors where conditions permit, with scheduled pauses for photos, shoreline viewpoints, and short town walks. Travelers cover key Pacific coast landmarks in one organized day without self-driving the full distance.
highlights: Day trip from San Francisco covering Monterey, Carmel, and Big Sur
Pacific coast sightseeing with Highway 1 segments when road conditions allow
Time in Monterey waterfront areas and Cannery Row district
Stop in Carmel-by-the-Sea for independent walking and photos
Scenic Big Sur viewpoints included in route planning

start.description: Hilton San Francisco Union Square, 333 O'Farrell St, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA

end.description: Returns to the original departure area in San Francisco.
